Kill the head of their clan, Khan Hratha! To face him, blow the Maraudine War Horn. It is atop a high bluff in the Valley of Spears. But to blow the horn, you must gain a warhorn mouthpiece. These are rare, carried only by trusted Maraudine centaur. After the horn is blown, centaur will come. Kill them until Hratha appears. Khan Hratha holds the piece of... a key. Bring it to me... Progress Is Khan Hratha dead? Do you have the key fragment? Completion He is dead! Khan Hratha is dead! And now the Maraudine will fall! When the Gelkis rule this land, <name>, we will remember you. 93128.bodyText: Khan Jehn Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace . Khan Jehn slain ( 1 ) Gelkis Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Description As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village. I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now. But <name>, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him. Completion Khan Jehn has been slain!? I do not believe it. I cannot believe it. This was brazen! Foolish! Nerlokh had no authority to suggest such an attack! Yet, if you are speaking the truth, I cannot deny that the defeat of Jehn bodes well for the future of our clan. A new Khan will soon take his place, but we have time to prepare our next move. I will speak with our Khan. For now, your work here is done. Bask in today's victory, but do not tempt fate further. 93196.bodyText: Khan Jehn Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village. Khan Jehn resurrected ( 1 ) Magram Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Provided item: Ultimate Necromancy Staff ( 1 ) Description The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan. You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis. Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider? <Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.> This is why. Completion The Gelkis recruit outsiders to perform underhanded war strategies, where our clan would send them off to die. And yet, here you are, <name>. An outsider who has demonstrated fierce loyalty to the Magram Clan despite being so unwelcome. I do not know your motivations, but I recognize first-hand your potential. You have my gratitude, and that of our clan. To us, you are no longer an outsider. To us, you are Magram. 92841.bodyText: Valley of Bones Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village. Magram Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Description It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it! Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul . You will know when you get there. You will know when you see him. If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know. And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown. Completion So the rumors are true. Unfortunate that Warug has had you running around with frivolous tasks. At least you proved your worth. Peer down into the valley below, what do you see? Bones and bodies. Roaming undead. And the Twin Goliaths. This place was cursed long before our arrival, and I suspect it will remain as such for many generations to come. Our clan was the first to brave the horrors below, and ours will be the only one to claim its power. Are you as eager as I to rule over all of Desolace? Gently Cursed Bone ( 426 ) Magram Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Description Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand. Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic. 92873.bodyText: Proof of Concept Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul . Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons. < Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.> I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it. Progress Despite your aid thus far, if you are unable to raise the dead then your usefulness with the Magram has come to an end. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive. This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom. 92894.bodyText: Bone Raising Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown. Summon or Slay Haggard Bones ( 10 ) Magram Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Provided item: Enhanced Necromancy Staff ( 1 ) Description I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet? Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further. As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic. I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back! Completion < Orgrul listens to your explanation, unable to suppress a grin.> Do not fret, outsider, for this experiment was anything but a failure. We now know how weak and fragile the Gelkis' form of necromancy is. They have a long way to go before they will match our might. The fact that you were able to seize control of any of them speaks highly of you, too. Despite those wasted skeletons, you have demonstrated your impressive capabilities. I will take the staff for now. There is more work to do. 93058.bodyText: Saving Our Own Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done. Gelkis Captive rescued ( 5 ) Gelkis Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Description There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside. <name>, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly. You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together. Completion When I first heard the stamping of hooves, I thought I was about to be pushed back to the village. Imagine my delight the moment I saw my brethren retreating past these arches, alive and well! I have directed the survivors to report to Uthek to share anything they might have learned. I do not anticipate reinforcements, <name>, but this bodes well for the future of our clan. Let us remain focused in our task. 93062.bodyText: Bone Burying Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones. Haggard Bones laid to rest ( 8 ) Gelkis Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Provided item: Uthek's Draenethyst Staff ( 1 ) Description About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic? I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt. Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits. Completion There is a weight lifted off my shoulders knowing that you restored peace to so many bodies. All my life I expected our clan wars to inevitably end in brutality and bloodshed. Never would I have guessed that I would be staring death in the face, with death staring right back. Thank you, again, <name>. 93066.bodyText: Bristleback Retreat Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace. Bristleback Nomad slain ( 4 ) Bristleback Thornweaver slain ( 6 ) Bristleback Skullcrusher slain ( 6 ) Magram Clan Centaur ( Honored ) Description On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay. This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. 93122.bodyText: Checking Things Out Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas . Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings. Description We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage. With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan? I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village... Completion <You summarize your findings.> Not one, but TWO camps? <You clarify that one camp is unquestionably Magram, but the other looks to belong to the outcasts.> This means that the Magram are likely in an active conflict. <name>, I think this may be our opportunity. Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too. When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees! Progress Slay their soldiers and starve the survivors. Their little hideaway should never be a sufficient staging ground against our clan again! Completion <Hagiak peeks into several of the crates without a word at first.> Of all things to bring out to the front lines, I would have never expected... nevermind. Some of these crates have food in them, and that's what matters. We've shortened the time they can survive here significantly. The ultimate victory for our clan grows nearer. guide.title: Collecting Library Books:  Locations and Rewards - WoW Forever - Wowhead
guide.guideMarkup:
[toc]

Finding books around Azeroth has always been an interesting way of finding snippets of lore while questing; in Season of Discovery, finding these books and then handing them in to the librarian was tied to a Mage Rune.  In World of Warcraft Forever, though, this has been expanded upon, and now players of all classes are able to collect books and hand them in, with new rewards.

[h2 type=bar toc="Rewards"]Quests & Rewards for Collecting Books in WoW Forever[/h2]
[pad]
[pad]
There are 3 known quests attached to library book collection, each one unlocking at a different number of books.

[item=281635][/td][/tr]

[/table][/center]


[h3 toc="Study"]Something Extra for Mages - Study[/h3]
[pad]

When Mages hand in their first book, they learn a new ability called [spell=1302508].  This ability is tied to the new spell Decipher Scrolls, learnt from a trainer at level 6.  When standing in the Library, Studying (consumes a light feather) provides you with a bundle of scrolls on a one-day cooldown.  

[center]
[screenshot id=1303677 width=400 border=2 alt="Mages Study" size=normal][/screenshot]

[h2 type=bar toc="Where to Hand In Books"]Where to Hand In Your Books in WoW Forever[/h2]
[pad]
[pad]

To hand in a book, you need to visit your Faction Librarian. Thankfully for [color=mage]Mages[/color], this is very close to your Mage Portal Trainer.
